title: Dead-slot (!node_alive) disjunct of the live-terminal anchor guard has no test — only the router (node_kind) disjunct is exercised
detail: A regression dropping only the alive check (keeping the kind check) passes every test in the diff, yet mid-game demolition followed by growth could re-anchor attaches on demolished positions — strays the strict doctrine deletes.
recommended_fix: Add a leg that demolishes a terminal mid-run (or one fixture terminal before run_growth) and re-runs the strict audit, pinning that dead slots never join the member set.

title: Seed-floor map-diameter bound: reject rows pinned at 50/51, but the pass-side boundary (49) is not pinned
evidence:
core/catalog_test.odin:720-721: `{"seed_tiles at map diameter", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 10`, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 50`, 1), "growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles"},
		{"seed_tiles above map diameter", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 10`, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 51`, 1), "growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles"},` — map is 40x30 (catalog_test.odin:94: `"map": {"w_tiles": 40, "h_tiles": 30, "tile_px": 26}}`) so diameter=50; the check is `>=` (catalog.odin:1013-1016: `if i64(b.growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles)*... >= i64(b.map_w_tiles)*... + i64(b.map_h_tiles)*...`). No row pins 49 loading clean.
detail: Only the reject side of the boundary is tested; an off-by-one tightening to `>` would silently reject 49 with no test failing. Happy-path coverage uses 10, far from the boundary.
recommended_fix: Add a positive loader row: new_area_seed_tiles 49 must load clean (mirroring the sibling bias-750 positive row style).

title: growth_seed_sep_ok degenerate guard (min_dist < 1) unpinned while the sibling attach predicate pins its degenerate case
evidence:
core/growth.odin:302-304: `if min_dist < 1 {
		return false // degenerate guard — fail-CLOSED, mirroring growth_attach_radius_ok (never a silent zero-floor accept)`. test_growth_seed_sep_predicate (growth_test.odin:783-791) only exercises seed_dist=10 cases (`!growth_seed_sep_ok(&s.topology, {25, 15}, seed_dist)` ... `growth_seed_sep_ok(&s.topology, {20, 29}, seed_dist)`), whereas test_growth_attach_radius_predicate pins its guard: growth_test.odin:839-840: `testing.expect(t, !growth_attach_radius_ok(&s.topology, 0, {25, 15}, 0), "a zero radius must never accept")`.
detail: Asymmetric pinning: the seed predicate's fail-closed guard is untested, so a regression flipping it to fail-open (silent zero-floor accept) would slip the unit pin. Defensive path, loader makes it unreachable.
recommended_fix: Add one line to test_growth_seed_sep_predicate: `testing.expect(t, !growth_seed_sep_ok(&s.topology, {20, 15}, 0), ...)` mirroring the attach predicate's zero-radius pin.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (strict attach-or-seed audited at caps 5+8 with mid-run seed, coin-miss seed pinned at bias 750, both predicates unit-pinned on reachable geometry, loader fail-fast rows for every named key). P1 ~92% (12/13 boundary checks; only the diameter pass-side row missing). Overall ~90%.
recommended_fix: Raise P1 to ~100% by adding the diameter-bound positive row (49), the seed-predicate degenerate-guard pin, and a demolish-mid-growth strict-audit leg for the dead-slot anchor disjunct.
